fixed.text: Identical twinning is 3 to 4 pairs in each thousand births, near one rate across the world, across the years and across maternal age, and identical twins seldom cluster in families. Twin births range from under 10 to up to 30 in each thousand deliveries across the world's regions, and fraternal twinning runs in families and goes with maternal age and parity.
